title: Promote a planned feature without recreating its knowledge
preconditions: A fresh planned feature has an Essay, story with criterion, label, milestone, associated design and prototype; save its identity, URL and all knowledge links before any promotion.

steps.action: Before promotion, open the feature Essay and story through ordinary reading links.
steps.expected_result: The planned feature URL exposes its Essay, subtext, milestone and story navigation.

steps.action: Before promotion, follow the planned feature criterion and associated design links.
steps.expected_result: The planned feature uses the same ordinary reader surfaces and associated design context as built features.

steps.action: Confirm the feature is in Roadmap and absent from Features; promote it to built exactly once and inspect both collections.
steps.expected_result: The feature moves from Roadmap to Features.

steps.action: After that single promotion, compare saved identity bytes and revisit the original URL, Essay, story and milestone.
steps.expected_result: Identity bytes, URL, Essay, story and milestone remain intact.

steps.action: Compare the saved label membership, design and prototype links after promotion.
steps.expected_result: Labels, design and prototype remain attached to the same feature.

steps.action: Open the criterion and associated design after promotion and compare with the planned views.
steps.expected_result: The ordinary reader retains the same authored intent and associated design.

expected_result: Promote a planned feature without recreating its knowledge.
